name: get_product_details
description: Label facts of products already found by search_product: active ingredient, strength, dosage form, route, pack size, price, prescription status, storage (fridge or room temperature, min/max °C, keep from light, keep dry, do not freeze), shelf life, manufacturer and country. Use for questions ABOUT a product ("does it need the fridge?", "how many in the box?", "is it made in Saudi?", "does it need a prescription?"). Never for dose, use or suitability.

product_ids.description: Up to 3 product_ids, to compare products.

returns.description: products: list of label facts; not_recorded lists facts missing from our system.

errors.when: a scheduled/controlled medicine - nothing is disclosed
